agencies.shortDescription: SSDC is a agency captured from Shopify's Partner Directory for the Jakarta market, with services including Business strategy guidance, POS setup and migration, Store build or redesign.
agencies.longDescription:
SSDC is included in the eStorefy Shopify provider database as a agency connected to Jakarta, Indonesia. The provider was captured from Shopify's public Partner Directory country listing and is listed in the target city; the source location shown in the captured listing is Jakarta. The service tags captured for this provider include Business strategy guidance, POS setup and migration, Store build or redesign, Store migration, and Store settings configuration. At the time of this research snapshot, the Shopify Partner Directory showed an aggregate rating of 5.0/5 from 26 published reviews.

For merchants comparing Shopify specialists, these service tags indicate the areas in which SSDC publicly appears to offer support. Depending on the project, that may include storefront creation or redesign, theme work, migration, troubleshooting, ecommerce optimization, integrations, ongoing management, or related commerce services. The exact scope should still be confirmed directly with the provider, because public directory listings can change and broad service categories do not replace a project-specific proposal.

This profile deliberately separates sourced facts from generated editorial copy. The provider name, source location, rating data when available, review count when available, and listed service categories come from the captured public source. This description and the FAQ explanations are generated to make the directory easier to browse and compare. eStorefy has not independently verified a staffed physical office, client outcomes, pricing, team size, awards, or individual customer review statements. Before publishing time-sensitive information or choosing a provider, recheck the linked Shopify directory source and contact the provider for current details.
